title: Creative Source
description: Pre-binding creative intake object that preserves multiple equivalent delivery representations under one logical creative and revision. `variant_semantics: "one_of"` is explicit: exactly one compatible representation is selected for a seller-bound manifest; these variants are not repeatable slot cardinality and MUST NOT rotate.

creative_id.description: Stable logical creative identifier across all representations and later seller-bound manifests.

revision_id.description: Immutable source revision identifier. A material source change creates a new revision; resolution does not.

variant_semantics.description: Exactly one compatible delivery representation may be selected for each seller-bound output.

delivery_variants.description: Equivalent source representations. `variant_id` values MUST be unique within this array and unsupported entries MUST be retained unchanged.

provenance.description: Default provenance for every retained representation and for the selected seller-bound output unless a variant supplies a narrower provenance object.
